ingredients.name: Kodo Millet
ingredients.detail: A cereal grain that contributes energy and dietary fibre.

ingredients.name: Navane (Foxtail Millet)
ingredients.detail: Adds cereal carbohydrate, plant protein and fibre; preparation affects the nutritional profile.

ingredients.name: Baragu (Proso Millet)
ingredients.detail: Contributes cereal energy and plant protein to a varied diet.

ingredients.name: Saame (Little Millet)
ingredients.detail: A small millet that contributes carbohydrate and dietary fibre, adding variety to cereal-based meals.

ingredients.name: Korale (Browntop Millet)
ingredients.detail: Adds cereal carbohydrate, plant protein and dietary fibre as one of the millets in the recipe.

ingredients.name: Oodhalu (Barnyard Millet)
ingredients.detail: Contributes carbohydrate, fibre and some plant protein.

ingredients.name: Almond
ingredients.detail: Provides vitamin E and unsaturated fats; vitamin E contributes to normal antioxidant function.
ingredients.reference_entry: Almonds, dry roasted, food sources table

ingredients.name: Walnut
ingredients.detail: Contains alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), a plant omega-3 fat; ALA is different from marine EPA and DHA.

ingredients.name: Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients.detail: Contributes magnesium, a mineral involved in normal muscle and nerve function.
ingredients.reference_entry: Pumpkin seeds, roasted, selected food sources

ingredients.name: Cucumber Seeds
ingredients.detail: Cucumber seed oil contains fatty acids, including linoleic acid, that contribute to the fat content of the seeds.

ingredients.name: Sunflower Seeds
ingredients.detail: Provides vitamin E, which contributes to normal antioxidant function.
ingredients.reference_entry: Sunflower seeds, dry roasted, food sources table

ingredients.name: Watermelon Seeds
ingredients.detail: Adds plant protein and fat; seed nutrients differ from those in the watery fruit pulp.
ingredients.reference_entry: USDA FDC 169407; Protein and Total lipid (fat), verified via USDA API

ingredients.name: Poppy Seeds
ingredients.detail: Contains fat and minerals, including calcium. The amount delivered depends on the portion used.

ingredients.name: Til (Sesame Seeds)
ingredients.detail: Adds fat and plant protein. Its nutrient contribution to a serving depends on the amount used.

ingredients.name: Fenugreek Seeds
ingredients.detail: Adds fibre and a characteristic flavour. Evidence is insufficient to promise digestive or blood-sugar benefits from this blend.
ingredients.reference_entry: G026 Fenugreek seeds; NCCIH evidence limitations

ingredients.name: Flax Seeds
ingredients.detail: Contributes alpha-linolenic acid, an essential plant omega-3 fatty acid.

ingredients.name: Bellar (Avare Kalu)
ingredients.detail: Whole field beans, also called avare kalu, contribute plant protein and carbohydrate. Cook before eating.
ingredients.reference_entry: Owner-confirmed whole form; TNAU lablab identity and field bean, dry composition

ingredients.name: Soya Beans
ingredients.detail: Contributes plant protein and fat. Soy is one of the allergens in the recipe.

ingredients.name: Raagi (Finger Millet)
ingredients.detail: Contains calcium, which contributes to normal bones and teeth as part of a balanced diet.

ingredients.name: Kabul Gram (Kabuli Chickpeas)
ingredients.detail: Contributes plant protein and fibre. Kabuli and black chana are varieties of chickpea, not different species.

ingredients.name: Green Gram (Mung Bean)
ingredients.detail: Adds plant protein and dietary fibre; whole and split forms have different fibre contents.

ingredients.name: Bellar Dal (Avare Bele)
ingredients.detail: The split form of Bellar, called avare bele, contributes plant protein. Splitting and removal of the seed coat change its fibre content.
ingredients.reference_entry: Owner-confirmed split form; general pulse composition, without assigning whole-seed nutrient quantities

ingredients.name: Cow Peas White
ingredients.detail: White cowpeas contribute plant protein, carbohydrate and dietary fibre.

ingredients.name: Cow Peas Brown
ingredients.detail: Brown cowpeas contribute plant protein, carbohydrate and dietary fibre.

ingredients.name: Green Peas
ingredients.detail: Adds plant protein and carbohydrate. Fresh and dried peas have different nutrient concentrations.

ingredients.name: White Peas
ingredients.detail: Dried peas contribute plant protein and fibre when cooked.

ingredients.name: Black Urad (Whole Black Gram)
ingredients.detail: Whole black gram contributes plant protein and fibre, including fibre from its seed coat.

ingredients.name: Barley (Barli)
ingredients.detail: A cereal that contributes carbohydrate and dietary fibre. Barley contains gluten and is unsuitable for a gluten-free diet.
ingredients.reference_entry: A004 Barley (Hordeum vulgare); owner confirmed Barli Rice means barley

ingredients.name: Sago (Sabudana)
ingredients.detail: Primarily contributes carbohydrate energy, with little protein or fibre. It is not a pulse or a type of rice.
ingredients.reference_entry: Tapioca, pearl, dry (sabudana starch comparison; not botanical identification)

ingredients.name: Rajma White
ingredients.detail: White kidney beans contribute plant protein and fibre when properly cooked.
ingredients.reference_entry: Rajmah; general protein and fibre only, not colour-specific

ingredients.name: Kidney Beans Red
ingredients.detail: Red kidney beans contribute plant protein and fibre; they must be properly processed and cooked.

ingredients.name: Kidney Beans Brown
ingredients.detail: Brown kidney beans contribute plant protein and dietary fibre when properly cooked.

ingredients.name: Horse Gram
ingredients.detail: Adds plant protein and dietary fibre to a varied diet.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.detail: A legume that contributes plant protein and fats. Peanut is an allergen, distinct from tree nuts.

ingredients.name: Chick Peas (Black Chana)
ingredients.detail: Whole chickpeas contribute plant protein and fibre; black chana is a chickpea variety.

ingredients.name: Urad Dal (Split Black Gram)
ingredients.detail: Split black gram contributes plant protein; removing the seed coat changes its fibre content.

ingredients.name: Masoor Dal (Lentils)
ingredients.detail: Contributes plant protein and fibre; nutrient values depend on the whole or split form.

ingredients.name: Moth Gram
ingredients.detail: Adds plant protein, carbohydrate and dietary fibre to a varied diet.

ingredients.name: Split Bengal Gram (Chana Dal)
ingredients.detail: Split chickpeas contribute plant protein; their fibre content differs from whole chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Jowar (Sorghum)
ingredients.detail: Contributes cereal carbohydrate, plant protein and fibre. This blend also contains barley and is not gluten-free.

ingredients.name: Elachi (Cardamom)
ingredients.detail: Adds a characteristic aroma and flavour in the small quantities used as a culinary spice.

ingredients.name: Jeera (Cumin Seeds)
ingredients.detail: Adds a distinctive aroma and flavour in the small quantities used as a culinary spice.
